messages.subject: Project Redwood – heads of terms finalised (subject to contract)
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

The heads of terms for Kingsgate House are now agreed with the agent and Belvedere, subject to contract. Key points: price £18,500,000; 10% deposit (£1,850,000) on exchange held as stakeholder; sold subject to the existing tenancies (passing rent c. £1,362,200 p.a.); TOGC treatment for VAT; each side bears its own costs.

I've saved the signed-off heads of terms to the matter file (Project_Redwood_HeadsOfTerms). We'll now wait for the draft contract from Marlowe Greaves.

Sarah Whitfield
Partner
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
